_meta.note: Structural (prose-free) snapshot of @agentclientprotocol/sdk, generated by scripts/regen-acp-snapshot.mjs and compared against the installed SDK by tests/acp-schema-drift.test.js (#7318). Does NOT capture description/title/x-method/x-side or any other prose -- see acp-schema-digest.mjs for the exact contract. Regenerate ONLY after a deliberate SDK version bump; see this file's own header.
